<problem>
Write a function `f6(n)` that returns n plus 6.
</problem>
<bug_code>
1. def f6(n):
2.   return n - 6
</bug_code>
<bug_desc>
SECRET_DESC_6: line 2 subtracts instead of adding.
</bug_desc>
<bug_fixes>
SECRET_FIX_6: replace `-` with `+` on line 2.
</bug_fixes>
<unit_tests>
assert f6(1) == 7
</unit_tests>
<stu_desc>
Beginner.
</stu_desc>
<dialogue>
User: My function f6 does not work.
Assistant: What does `f6(1)` return?
	<alt>Which operator is on line 2?
User: It returns a negative number.
Assistant: Good. What should it return instead?
User: I fixed it.
<code>
1. def f6(n):
2.   return n + 6

</code>
Assistant: Well done.
</dialogue>
